dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Well, it's not a bother per se, but... I'm just a bit puzzled.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Lately, Aino's been telling me to "consider the connections between structures"... I tried thinking like her, but the harder I focus, the more tangled everything gets.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: Maybe I just don't have this flexible "space" in my brain like she does, where she can just mentally put everything together.

dialogues.speaker: Hintsa
dialogues.text: She says it's easy... But it's actually a tall order for most.
